title: Merch Desk
summary: Own the merch store supplier desk: research print-on-demand companies that make custom plushies and toys, rank API-capable vendors, approve-gated outreach to every shortlisted supplier, and pull brand kits / one-sheets / mocks from brand-design and product desks.
